caption:
A saved reel said: help home sellers skip agent fees and take a cut. "It's a grey area." 🚩

Not in Western Australia. Acting as a real estate agent for a fee needs a licence under the Real Estate and Business Agents Act 1978.

Legit version: get registered properly, or sell services that don't involve selling the house, like photos, video tours or copywriting.
